acceptanceCriteria.passesWhen: `report build --silent` produces no progress output on stdout

acceptanceCriteria.check: The old spelling still works and warns
acceptanceCriteria.passesWhen: `report build --quiet` behaves as --silent and prints `--quiet is deprecated; use --silent` to stderr

acceptanceCriteria.check: Both spellings together are a usage error
acceptanceCriteria.passesWhen: The command exits 2 and the message names both --quiet and --silent

acceptanceCriteria.check: The deprecation notice leaves stdout untouched
acceptanceCriteria.passesWhen: Piping stdout of `report build --quiet` yields the same bytes as `--silent`

acceptanceCriteria.check: Help documents only the new spelling
acceptanceCriteria.passesWhen: `report build --help` lists --silent and does not list --quiet
